name: Sno Memory for OpenClaw
description: SQLite + sqlite-vec long-term memory plugin for OpenClaw with precision recall retrieval, insight distillation, multi-scope isolation, and management CLI

embedding.sessionOptions.label: ONNX Session Options
embedding.sessionOptions.help: Low-memory local ONNX settings. Default disables memory pattern and CPU arena.

embedding.chunking.label: Enable Chunking
embedding.chunking.help: Enable text chunking for long passages. When disabled, long text is silently truncated by the model.

embedding.normalized.label: Normalized Embeddings
embedding.normalized.help: Request normalized embeddings when the provider supports it

provider.userId.label: Provider User ID
provider.userId.help: Trusted Sno user UUID-v7 used by the native OpenClaw memory provider.

extraction.llm.preset.label: Extraction LLM Preset
extraction.llm.preset.help: Signed LLMIx preset for model-backed extraction and reflection generation.

extraction.llm.baseURL.label: Extraction LLM Base URL
extraction.llm.baseURL.help: Override provider default / env baseURL. Supports ${ENV_VAR} placeholders.

extraction.llm.heliconeApiKey.label: Helicone API Key
extraction.llm.heliconeApiKey.help: Enables Helicone logging for OpenAI-compatible extraction calls. Defaults to HELICONE_API_KEY env.

extraction.llm.timeoutMs.label: Extraction LLM Timeout (ms)
extraction.llm.timeoutMs.help: Per-request timeout for extraction LLM call.

ambientLearning.label: Ambient Learning
ambientLearning.help: Learns durable conversation signals in the background

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Automatically inject relevant memories into agent context (default: off)

autoRecallMinLength.label: Auto-Recall Min Length
autoRecallMinLength.help: Minimum prompt length to trigger auto-recall (shorter prompts are skipped). Default: 15 chars for English, 6 for CJK.

autoRecallMinRepeated.label: Auto-Recall Dedup Turns
autoRecallMinRepeated.help: Skip re-injecting a memory if shown within last N turns (0 = no dedup)

autoRecallMaxQueryLength.label: Auto-Recall Max Query Length
autoRecallMaxQueryLength.help: Maximum character length of the auto-recall query before truncation. Default: 2000.

autoRecallTimeoutMs.label: Auto-Recall Timeout (ms)
autoRecallTimeoutMs.help: Timeout for the entire auto-recall pipeline (embed + search + rerank). Default: 5000.

captureAssistant.label: Capture Assistant Messages
captureAssistant.help: Also ambient-learning assistant messages (default false to reduce memory pollution)

retrieval.recallTopK.label: Recall Top-K
retrieval.recallTopK.help: Memories injected into the agent per turn. Default 20 (tuned for the 384-token retrieval chunk profile). Lean 15 for ~20-25% fewer injected tokens. Re-tune later via Control UI; gateway restart may be required.

retrieval.mode.label: Retrieval Mode
retrieval.mode.help: Use precision recall search (vector + BM25) or vector-only

retrieval.vectorWeight.label: Vector Search Weight
retrieval.vectorWeight.help: Weight for vector similarity in precision recall search (0-1)

retrieval.bm25Weight.label: BM25 Search Weight
retrieval.bm25Weight.help: Weight for BM25 keyword search in precision recall search (0-1)

retrieval.rerank.label: Reranking Mode
retrieval.rerank.help: Re-score fused results (cross-encoder uses configured reranker API)

retrieval.rerankEndpoint.label: Reranker Endpoint
retrieval.rerankEndpoint.help: Custom reranker API endpoint URL; env placeholders are resolved at runtime

retrieval.rerankProvider.label: Reranker Provider
retrieval.rerankProvider.help: Provider format: voyage (default), jina, siliconflow, pinecone, dashscope, tei, or custom

retrieval.rerankMaxCandidates.label: Rerank Batch Cap
retrieval.rerankMaxCandidates.help: Hard cap on candidates sent per rerank request. Set this if your reranker (e.g. a self-hosted tei deployment) rejects large batches instead of truncating them.

retrieval.temporalExpiry.label: Temporal Expiry Filter
retrieval.temporalExpiry.help: Drop memories past their valid_until timestamp. Default: false (needs A/B evaluation).

retrieval.rerankTimeoutMs.label: Rerank Timeout (ms)
retrieval.rerankTimeoutMs.help: Abort external rerank request after this timeout

retrieval.minScore.label: Min Score
retrieval.minScore.help: Minimum retrieval score after importance weighting and optional length normalization. Default: 0.

retrieval.hardMinScore.label: Hard Minimum Score
retrieval.hardMinScore.help: Discard results below this score after all scoring stages

retrieval.candidatePoolSize.label: Candidate Pool Size
retrieval.candidatePoolSize.help: Number of candidates to fetch before fusion and reranking

retrieval.lengthNormAnchor.label: Length Normalization Anchor
retrieval.lengthNormAnchor.help: Entries longer than this (chars) get score penalized. 0 = disabled.

tier.coreAccessThreshold.label: Core Access Threshold
tier.coreAccessThreshold.help: Minimum recall count before promoting to core.

tier.coreCompositeThreshold.label: Core Composite Threshold
tier.coreCompositeThreshold.help: Minimum lifecycle composite before promoting to core.

tier.peripheralCompositeThreshold.label: Peripheral Composite Threshold
tier.peripheralCompositeThreshold.help: Memories below this lifecycle score can demote to peripheral.

tier.peripheralAgeDays.label: Peripheral Age Days
tier.peripheralAgeDays.help: Age threshold for demoting stale working memories.

scopes.definitions.label: Scope Definitions
scopes.definitions.help: Define custom memory scopes with descriptions

scopes.agentAccess.label: Agent Access Control
scopes.agentAccess.help: Define which scopes each agent can access

sessionMemory.enabled.label: Session Memory (Deprecated)
sessionMemory.enabled.help: Legacy compatibility: true maps to systemSessionMemory, false maps to none.

selfImprovement.enabled.label: Self-Improvement
selfImprovement.enabled.help: Enable self-improvement reminder and governance tools

selfImprovement.skipSubagentBootstrap.label: Skip Subagent Bootstrap
selfImprovement.skipSubagentBootstrap.help: Do not inject reminder file into subagent bootstrap context

enableManagementTools.label: Management Tools
enableManagementTools.help: Enable management/debug tools such as memory_list, memory_stats, and governance-oriented self-improvement review/extract actions.

memoryReflection.messageCount.label: Reflection Message Count
memoryReflection.messageCount.help: Recent messages included in reflection input

memoryReflection.maxInputChars.label: Reflection Max Input Chars
memoryReflection.maxInputChars.help: Max prompt chars sent to reflection run

memoryReflection.timeoutMs.label: Reflection Timeout (ms)
memoryReflection.timeoutMs.help: Timeout for reflection generation LLM call

memoryReflection.errorReminderMaxEntries.label: Error Reminder Max Entries
memoryReflection.errorReminderMaxEntries.help: Max recent error hints injected into prompts

memoryReflection.dedupeErrorSignals.label: Dedupe Error Signals
memoryReflection.dedupeErrorSignals.help: Deduplicate repeated error signatures per session

memoryReflection.storeToDb.label: Store Reflections to DB
memoryReflection.storeToDb.help: Store reflection entries in sqlite-vec for semantic search

memoryReflection.agentId.label: Reflection Agent ID
memoryReflection.agentId.help: Override agent ID for reflection generation (defaults to source agent)

sessionOptions.description: Low-memory ONNX Runtime profile for local embedding.

chunking.description: Enable text chunking for long passages. When false, long text is silently truncated by the model.

enableManagementTools.description: Enable management/debug tools such as memory_list, memory_stats, and governance-oriented self-improvement review/extract actions

extraction.description: Memory extraction tuning and optional LLM route config. Product mode selects deterministic or model-backed extraction.

llm.description: LLM config for agent-native and rem-enhanced modes. Always resolves to a valid object via defaults.

sessionStrategy.description: Choose session pipeline: plugin memory-reflection, built-in session-memory, or none

autoRecallMaxQueryLength.description: Maximum character length of the auto-recall query before truncation. Default: 2000.

autoRecallTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in ms for the entire auto-recall pipeline (embed + search + rerank). Default: 5000.

recallTopK.description: Top-K memories injected per turn during auto-recall. Default 20 (tuned for the 384-token retrieval chunk profile). Lean 15 for ~20-25% fewer injected tokens.

minScore.description: Minimum post-pipeline score for retrieved memories (0–1). Applied after time-decay/importance/length shrinkers, which can compress a genuinely relevant match to 0.03-0.06 — a nonzero default here silently empties recall in production. Raise only with fresh measured data.

rerankEndpoint.description: Custom reranker API endpoint URL; env placeholders are resolved at runtime.

rerankMaxCandidates.description: Hard cap on candidates sent per rerank API request. Self-hosted deployments (e.g. a text-embeddings-inference / "tei" reranker) commonly reject an over-limit batch outright instead of truncating it, which silently degrades every rerank call to a no-op fallback. Candidates beyond the cap are never dropped — they still flow through the standard unreturned-candidate preservation path. Defaults to 50 when rerankProvider is "tei" and this is unset.

temporalExpiry.description: Drop memories past their valid_until timestamp. Default: false (needs A/B evaluation).

lengthNormAnchor.description: 0 disables length normalization. Was 500; confirmed actively harmful (demotes memories by parent-document length, not by relevance) and never re-enable without fresh calibration against real chunk geometry.

decay.description: Weibull decay engine parameters for memory lifecycle management.

tier.description: Memory tier promotion/demotion thresholds (core / working / peripheral).

sessionMemory.description: Deprecated legacy switch. Kept for compatibility and mapped to sessionStrategy.

memoryReflection.description: Configuration for the memoryReflection session strategy.
